DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの品にいたしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 生の魚は避けたいので、炙りの魚なら中まで火が通っていると思い選びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 生もの回避のため炙りを加熱済みと考えたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to avoid raw fish, so I chose seared fish thinking it would be cooked all the way through.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you assumed seared fish was fully cooked when trying to avoid raw food. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 炙りという名前だけで、中まで加熱されているとは判断できません。調理方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The name ‘seared’ alone doesn't tell us it's cooked through. I'll check the cooking method.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表面だけの場合もあるのですね。まだ注文を決めず、候補の仕上がりを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 注文前に具体的な加熱状態の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So sometimes only the surface is cooked. I won't decide the order yet; I'd like to hear how the possible dishes are finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request an explanation of the specific cooking state before ordering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 調理担当へ確認します。生の魚以外にも、避けたい条件はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the cooking staff. Apart from raw fish, are there any other conditions you want to avoid?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まずは中まで加熱されている品を探しています。自分で炙りを全部同じ扱いにせず、具体的な品で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前で一括判断せず品ごとに確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: For now I'm looking for something cooked through. Rather than treat everything called seared the same, I'll ask about a specific dish.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check each dish rather than judging them all by name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この二品の材料と仕上げについて説明します。食べられるかの最終判断はご自身でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain the ingredients and finish of these two dishes. Please make the final decision yourself about whether you can eat them.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明を聞くと一品は希望と違いました。もう一品も材料を聞いてから決めたいので、まだ通さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一候補を外し残る品の材料確認まで保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: From the explanation, one doesn't meet my preference. I'd like the ingredients of the other before deciding too, so don't put it through yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Eliminate one option and hold the other until its ingredients are checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。候補の材料を確認する間、注文は確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We won't finalize the order while checking the possible dish's ingredients.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 材料と加熱の説明を聞きました。自分の希望に合うと判断したこちらを一つお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 材料と加熱説明を基に選んだ一品を注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've heard the ingredient and cooking explanations. One of this dish that I've judged meets my preference, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Order one dish chosen on the basis of ingredient and cooking explanations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちら一つですね。確認した品だけ注文を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: One of this, correct. We'll accept an order only for the dish checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座開設の目的を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me why you'd like to open an account.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父の生活費を管理したいです。私が手続きに来たので、父の名前で作って私が使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父名義の口座を自分が開設利用したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to manage my father's living expenses. Since I've come to handle it, can I open it in his name and use it myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about opening and using an account in your father's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申込者、名義人、利用する方を分けて確認する必要があります。お父様の申込みか、ご自身の申込みかを整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to distinguish the applicant, account holder, and user. Let's clarify whether it's your father's application or your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 父の名義なら私の口座と同じには扱えませんね。父の手続きを代理で済ませられると考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 申込者と名義人の違いを認め代理を想定したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: If it's in my father's name, it can't be treated like my own account. I thought I could complete his procedure as a proxy.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the difference between applicant and account holder and explain that you assumed proxy action. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 代理の可否や必要な確認は担当が案内します。お父様は本日の来店についてご存じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will explain whether a proxy is possible and what must be checked. Does your father know about today's visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相談に来ることは伝えていますが、申込内容を父と決めたわけではありません。今日は条件を聞くだけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父は相談だけ了承し申込内容未定だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I told him I'd come to ask, but we haven't decided the application details together. Today I'll just ask about the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your father knows only about the consultation and the application details are undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人の口座に父の名前を記入して進めることはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Don't proceed by putting your father's name on an application for your own account.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。自分名義の申込みへ父の情報を混ぜません。本人が相談する方法と必要な確認事項を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の申込に父の情報を混ぜず本人の相談方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't mix his information into an application in my name. Please tell me how he can consult and what needs confirming.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not mix your father's details into your application and ask how he can consult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が案内します。口座が作れることや、ご家族が利用できることをここでは確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain. We aren't confirming here that an account can be opened or used by a family member.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を父へ伝え、名義と利用目的を整理してから本人の相談方法を選びます。今日は申込みを出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 父と名義目的を整理し条件確認後に相談方法を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my father the explanation, clarify the name and intended use, and then choose how he should consult. I won't submit an application today.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Clarify the name and purpose with your father and choose the consultation method after checking conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、相談方法をご案内します。ご家族の情報は必要な範囲で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll explain consultation methods. Let's check family information only as far as needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの書類についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which documents are you asking about?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 計算画面には戻る金額が出たのに、この紙には納付とあります。相殺して残りだけ払えばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 還付画面と納付書を相殺できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The calculation screen showed money to be returned, but this paper says payment. Can I offset them and pay only the difference?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the refund screen and payment notice can be offset. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの税目、対象期間、計算の状態を確認します。数字だけで差し引く判断はしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the tax types, periods, and calculation statuses separately. Don't decide to subtract them just from the numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つを同じ手続きの金額だと思っていました。画面の印刷と納付の紙を別に見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二つの資料を別に提示して対象確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought they were amounts from the same procedure. I'd like you to look at the screen printout and payment paper separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Present the two documents separately and request confirmation of what they cover. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの画面は入力途中の結果ですね。申告を送信した状態かも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: This screen is a result partway through entering information. Let's also check whether the return has been submitted.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ送信していません。還付が確定したと扱わず、入力内容と紙の対象を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未送信と申告し還付確定とは扱わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't submitted it yet. I won't treat the refund as confirmed; I'll have the staff check my entries and what the paper covers.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that it is unsubmitted and do not treat the refund as confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 納付の紙の期限も残していますか。確認が済むまで、期限がなくなったとは考えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you still have the deadline on the payment paper? Don't assume that deadline disappears while we check.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紙はそのままあります。期限を見て、今日の確認で解決しなければ必要な相談先と手順を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 納付期限を保持し未解決時の相談手順を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I still have the paper as it is. I'll check the deadline, and if today's check doesn't resolve it, I'll ask whom to consult and what steps are needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Preserve the payment deadline and ask the consultation steps if unresolved. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ二つの資料をお渡しください。対応する税目と期間から整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please give both documents to the person in charge. We'll start by sorting out the corresponding tax types and periods.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分で差額を書き込まず、資料の対象と申告状況を確認してから支払いの要否を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 差額を自己記入せず税目期間と申告状態を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't write in a difference myself. After checking what the documents cover and the filing status, I'll ask whether payment is required.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not enter a self-calculated difference; clarify tax types, periods, and filing status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では担当が確認します。入力途中の画面であることも伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then the staff will check. Tell them the screen is still partway through data entry too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そちらの札は、展示用です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: That label is part of the exhibit.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 名刺くらいの大きさなので、作品紹介の持ち帰りカードだと思いました。まだ取っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小札を持ち帰りカードと思い未接触だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's about business-card size, so I thought it was an artwork information card to take home. I haven't taken it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought the small label was a takeaway card and have not touched it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 作品を識別する展示札です。持ち帰れる案内は受付で別にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's an exhibit label identifying the work. Reception can separately explain what information you may take home.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 展示の一部でしたか。位置を変えず、作品名だけ手元のメモへ書いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 展示札を動かさず文字メモできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it's part of the exhibit. Without moving it, may I just write the work's name in my own notes?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may take written notes without moving the exhibit label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: メモはできます。撮影や複製については、展示ごとの案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can take notes. For photography and reproduction, check the guidance for each exhibit.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 札を持って写真に入れることはしません。あとで作品を問い合わせたいので、作家名と作品名を控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 札を撮影小物にせず作家名作品名を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't hold the label up to include it in a photo. I want to inquire about the work later, so I'll note the artist's and work's names.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not use the label as a photo prop; record artist and work names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 問い合わせには作品番号も役立ちます。受付で案内できる内容は確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The work number can help with inquiries too. I'll check what reception can tell you.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号も追加します。札にある数字を販売価格と決めつけず、作品の識別番号として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作品番号を価格と区別して控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll add the number too. I won't assume the label's digits are a sale price; I'll give them as the work's identification number.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Record the work number separately from a price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。持ち帰り資料をご希望なら、受付へお声掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If you'd like material to take home, please ask reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この三つを控えました。札には触れず、受付で資料の有無と問い合わせ方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札に触れず資料と問い合わせ方法を受付で聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've noted those three things. I won't touch the label; I'll ask reception whether materials are available and how to inquire.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask reception about materials and inquiries without touching the label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では受付へどうぞ。展示札はそのままご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to reception, then. View the exhibit label where it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬の説明を始めます。気になる点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll begin explaining your medicines. Is anything concerning you?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋がたくさんあるので、薬の種類が前より増えたと思いました。全部違う薬ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 包装袋数を薬の種類増加と考えた疑問を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are lots of bags, so I thought I had more types of medicine than before. Are they all different medicines?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your question based on assuming more packaging bags meant more medicine types. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋の数と薬の種類数は別です。包装方法と処方の内容を薬剤師が説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The number of bags and number of medicines are different things. The pharmacist will explain the packaging method and prescription.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋一つを一種類と数えていました。中身を自分で出す前に、今回の薬の一覧を見て説明してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋を開けず今回の薬一覧で説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was counting each bag as one type. Before taking anything out myself, I'd like an explanation using the current medicine list.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Keep the bags closed and request an explanation using the current medicine list. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 薬剤師が一覧と袋の表示を確認します。前回の情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The pharmacist will check the list and bag labels. Do you have the previous information?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お薬手帳があります。前回と今回を比べる時も、袋の見た目だけで変更を判断しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: お薬手帳を示し見た目だけで処方変更を判断しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my medicine notebook. When comparing last time and now, I won't judge a prescription change just from the bags' appearance.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your medicine notebook and do not judge prescription changes from appearance alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その手帳を薬剤師に見せてください。飲む時刻の表示も一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show that notebook to the pharmacist. We'll check the time-of-day labels together too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 朝と夕方の表示があります。袋の数が多いから飲む回数を減らすことはせず、指示を聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋数を理由に服用回数を変えず時刻指示を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are morning and evening labels. I won't reduce how often I take it because there are many bags; I'll ask for the instructions again.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not change dose frequency because of the bag count; ask for timing instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。分からないまま飲み方を変えないでください。薬剤師から確認を受けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Don't change how you take medicine while unsure. Let's have the pharmacist check with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手帳と今回の一覧を見せ、種類と飲む時刻を分けて確認します。理解できた内容を言い返して確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 種類と時刻を分け復唱確認をしたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the notebook and current list and check types separately from taking times. I'd like to repeat back what I've understood to confirm it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to check types and times separately and confirm by repeating back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 薬剤師を呼びます。袋は開けずにそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll call the pharmacist. Please keep the bags unopened as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この箱の中身は本でよろしいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 本です。ただ、友人に返すお金を封筒に入れ、本の間に挟んであります。箱ごと普通に送れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本の中の現金を申告し普通の荷物で出せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Books, yes. But I've put money I'm returning to a friend in an envelope between the books. Can I send the whole box normally?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Declare cash among the books and ask whether it can go as ordinary parcel mail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現金が含まれる場合は、通常の荷物としてそのまま受け付けず、扱いを確認します。まだ封を閉じていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: If cash is included, we won't accept it unchanged as an ordinary parcel; we'll check the handling. You haven't sealed it yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。本だけと言ったのは不正確でした。自分の箱を開けて現金の封筒を取り出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未封緘と内容申告の不足を認め現金を外したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. Saying it was only books was inaccurate. I'll open my box and take out the cash envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is unsealed, acknowledge the incomplete contents declaration, and request to remove the cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで中身を確認する方法を担当が案内します。現金を見えなくして、本だけと申し出直すことはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will explain how we'll check the contents. Don't hide the cash and simply redeclare it as books only.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 隠すためではなく、別に保管するために取り出します。取り出した後の本と箱の状態も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 隠蔽でなく別保管のためと説明し箱の再確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm removing it to store separately, not to hide it. I'd also like to check the books and box after taking it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the cash is for separate storage rather than concealment and request another box check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当と確認しましょう。現金の封筒は、お客様ご自身で管理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check with the person in charge. Please manage the cash envelope yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 封筒は自分のバッグへ入れました。本の間にも残っていないことを、自分で一冊ずつ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現金を自己管理し本に残っていないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've put the envelope in my own bag. I'll check each book myself to make sure no cash remains between them either.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Manage the cash yourself and check that none remains in the books. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現金を送る必要があるなら、別に対応方法をご案内します。本の発送はどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you need to send cash, we can explain appropriate methods separately. What would you like to do about the books?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は本だけの発送方法を相談します。お金は持ち帰り、友人と返し方を決めてから別に対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本だけの発送を相談し現金は持ち帰って返し方を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll ask only how to send the books. I'll take the money home and handle it separately after deciding with my friend how to repay it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about sending only books, take the cash home, and decide a repayment method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、現金を外した箱の内容と、本に適した発送方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's check the box contents after removing cash and a suitable mailing method for the books.

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの便をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which service are you looking for?

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約には駅前とあるので、この停留所で高速バスを待っています。行先が表示されません。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駅名一致だけで待つ場所を決めたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-02.translation: The reservation says ‘in front of the station,’ so I'm waiting for the highway bus at this stop. Its destination isn't displayed.
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you chose the waiting place based only on the matching station name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ駅名の停留所が複数あります。予約に乗場の詳しい案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are multiple stops with the same station name. Does your reservation include detailed boarding instructions?

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メールの下に南側の案内図がありました。今は北側なので、駅名だけで場所を決めていました。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約図の南北と現在地の不一致に気づく。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-04.translation: There was a south-side map at the bottom of the email. I'm on the north side now; I'd chosen the place based only on the station name.
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Notice the mismatch between north and south on the reservation map and your location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約の案内と現在地を照合しましょう。荷物を持って移動されますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's compare the reservation guidance with your current location. Will you move with luggage?

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きなケースがあります。バスを追いかけるのでなく、南側へ通れる経路を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ケースを持って使える移動経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a large case. Rather than chase the bus, I'd like to check a route I can use to reach the south side.
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a route you can use while carrying your case. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当日の通路案内を見てください。ここから車道を横切らず、駅の案内された通路を使います。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check today's passage guidance. Don't cross the roadway from here; use the indicated station passage.

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路の入口から移動します。同行者もここへ向かっているので、今の待ち場所が違うと先に知らせます。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定通路を使い同行者へ場所訂正を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll go via the passage entrance. My companion is heading here too, so I'll first tell them this waiting place is wrong.
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use the designated passage and tell your companion the corrected location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 南側に着いてからも、予約便の乗場表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Even after reaching the south side, check the boarding sign for your reserved service.

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。同行者へ南側の案内図を送り、到着後に便名と乗場を照合してから待ちます。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 到着後も便名と乗場を照合すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll send my companion the south-side map and, after arriving, compare the service name and boarding point before waiting.
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will compare the service name and boarding point even after arriving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では案内された通路へどうぞ。駅名が同じでも乗場は分けて確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use the indicated passage. Even with the same station name, check the boarding points separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その機械は乾燥専用です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: That machine is a dryer only.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 洗濯機が空くまで、先にここで回してから洗えば時間を短くできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未洗濯の衣類を空き乾燥機で先に回せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Could I save time by running the clothes here first and washing them once a washing machine becomes free?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may put unwashed clothes in an available dryer first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 洗濯と乾燥の用途を分けて確認してください。汚れた衣類を先に乾燥させる案内はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please distinguish washing and drying purposes. We aren't advising drying dirty clothes first.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 空いている機械から使えばよいと思っていました。まだ入れていません。洗濯できる機械を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未投入と伝え洗濯用途の機械を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I should use whichever machine was free. I haven't put anything in yet. I'd like to check which machine can wash.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not loaded it and look for a washing machine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが洗濯機です。衣類がこの機械の対象になるか、表示も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: These are the washing machines. Also check the labels to see whether your items are suitable for this machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 毛布もあります。服と同じ扱いにせず、毛布の表示と機械の対象を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 毛布を服と分けタグと対象表示を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a blanket too. I'll treat it separately from clothes and compare the blanket label with the machine's accepted items.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate the blanket from clothing and compare its tag with the machine's usage label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 大きさや素材で確認が必要です。表示が読めない物は、今ここで使えると判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The size and material need checking. If you can't read an item's label, don't decide here that it can be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 毛布のタグが薄くて読めません。毛布は持ち帰り、表示が確認できた衣類だけで洗濯を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: タグ不読の毛布を除き確認可能な衣類だけ選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The blanket tag is too faded to read. I'll take the blanket home and consider washing only clothes whose labels I could confirm.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Exclude the blanket with an unreadable tag and select only confirmable clothing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その衣類の量と機械の案内を確認してから選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's choose after checking that clothing's quantity and the machine instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。未洗濯の物を乾燥機へ入れず、対象が確認できた衣類で洗濯機を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先乾燥をやめ対象と量で洗濯機を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't put unwashed items in the dryer. I'll choose a washer for clothes confirmed as suitable.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Abandon drying first and choose a washer based on suitability and quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では洗濯機の案内を見ましょう。乾燥は洗濯後に別に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's look at the washer guidance. We can check drying separately after washing.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: スープを濃いめで伺っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I've taken your order for stronger soup.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、麺を硬めにしたいと言ったつもりでした。スープの濃さは変える希望ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 麺硬さをスープ濃さの注文から訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry, I meant to ask for firmer noodles. I didn't want to change the soup's strength.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the soup-strength order to your intended noodle firmness. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 麺の仕上がりのご希望ですね。調理前か確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it's the noodle texture you want. I'll check whether cooking has begun.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ変更できるかを聞いてからお願いしたいです。言い直しただけで調理が直ったとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 調理状況を確認してから変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to request the change after checking whether it's still possible. I won't assume correcting my words alone changes the cooking.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to change after checking the cooking status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では調理前でした。麺の硬さを担当へ伝え、スープは元の注文内容にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this situation, cooking hadn't started. I'll tell the staff the noodle preference and keep the soup as originally ordered.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。ほかの人の注文も濃いめへ変えないよう、私の一杯だけの訂正として伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の一杯だけの訂正と指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Make it a correction for just my bowl so other people's orders aren't changed to stronger soup too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify that the correction is for only your bowl. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: あなたの注文はこちらの一杯ですね。追加の麺は注文されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: This one bowl is yours, correct? Have you ordered extra noodles?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 追加はしていません。硬めという希望は量を増やす意味でもないので、一杯の量は変えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加麺はなく硬さ希望と量を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: No extras. Firmer doesn't mean a larger quantity either, so the amount in my bowl stays the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say there are no extra noodles and distinguish firmness from quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できました。麺の希望とスープ、量を分けて注文を読み返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've confirmed that. I'll read the order back, separating noodles, soup, and quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。麺は希望の仕上がり、スープは元の内容、追加なしの一杯でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 麺スープ量の復唱を確認して注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. The noodles with my preferred finish, the original soup, and one bowl with no extras, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the readback of noodles, soup, and quantity and place the order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を担当へ伝えます。変更したのは麺の希望だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the cooking staff those details. Only the noodle preference has changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診で分からない項目はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there any unclear items in the medical questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族歴に、同居している友人の咳を書きました。同じ家に住む人の今の症状を書く欄ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族歴に同居友人の現症状を書いた疑問を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote my housemate friend's cough under family history. Is that a field for current symptoms of people living in the same home?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about entering a housemate friend's current symptoms in family history. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その欄の目的は診療担当が説明します。同居人の今の症状とは別に確認する内容があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The medical staff will explain the field's purpose. There are things to check separately from a housemate's current symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族という言葉を同じ住まいの人と読んでいました。自分の記入を見せて、適切な欄を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同居と家族歴の意味を混同したと認め欄を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I read ‘family’ as people in the same home. I'd like to show what I wrote and ask for the appropriate field.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge confusion between shared residence and family history and check the field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。ご自身の症状についても、分けて説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the medical staff. Please also explain your own symptoms separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分は昨日から咳があります。友人は先週からですが、その情報が自分の発症日ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分と友人の症状開始時点を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've had a cough since yesterday. My friend has had one since last week, but that isn't my onset date.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate the onset times of your symptoms and your friend's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの時点と、誰から聞いた情報かも分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also distinguish each timing and whom you heard the information from.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人の時点は本人から聞いた話です。自分が毎日観察した記録ではないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人情報は本人からの伝聞と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I heard my friend's timing from them. I'll say it isn't a record of my own daily observations.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend's information is something they told you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。家族歴の説明を受けてから、不明な部分を記入できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. After hearing the family-history explanation, you can fill in unclear parts.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。血縁者の病歴で分からない所は推測せず、同居人の話と自分の症状を分けて担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明病歴を推測せず三つの情報を担当へ分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I won't guess unknown parts of blood relatives' medical histories. I'll tell the staff separately about those, my housemate, and my own symptoms.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not guess unknown medical histories; distinguish the three kinds of information for the staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を引き継ぎます。記入欄の説明をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass those details on. Please wait for the explanation of the field.
